propositions: Pass-3 calculations are deterministic and fully persisted in sidecars but the live production path orchestrator.pass3_over_findings applies registry-dependent thresholds and execution_review-conditional bumps that may diverge from stored verdicts

The harness must replay three independent decision lenses per finding (stored, replayed-stored from persisted sidecar data, live-baseline from current orchestrator code) to detect registry drift and model version skew

Individual findings lacking persisted block_threshold values must be excluded per-finding rather than assigned fabricated defaults, and prerequisite-coverage-indeterminate verdicts reclassified by review-level overrides are not replayable from sidecar alone
Era-correct impact model selection requires using the impact formula in effect when a row was judged (plan-v4 baseline for legacy rows, plan-v5 for current), not always the current model

The tier-0 harness produces flip matrices including friction rate (findings where live-baseline non-blocking but candidate blocking) and registry-drift deltas, with optional label-proxy metrics when a labels file is supplied
